official: 非常勤の特別職の職員の報酬及び費用弁償に関する条例の一部を改正する条例設定について
committee: 予算等審査特別委員会
name: 保育園・学校などの非常勤医師らの報酬を引き上げる
summary: 非常勤の特別職の職員の報酬額は、条例で定められています。この議案では、産業医や保育園・学校の医師などの報酬額を改定し、令和8年4月1日から施行します。
changes: 産業医の月額報酬の上限を634,000円から672,000円に上げる
保育園の嘱託医の年額報酬を、0歳児を保育する園の内科医は520,000円から551,000円、その他の園の内科医は295,000円から313,000円、歯科医は130,000円から137,000円に上げる
看護専門学校校医の年額報酬を124,000円から131,000円に上げる
学校医等の年額報酬を、内科医は690,000円以内から732,000円以内、眼科医・耳鼻咽喉科医・学校歯科医は各556,000円以内から589,000円以内、精神科医は630,000円から668,000円、学校薬剤師は315,000円以内から334,000円以内に上げる
who: 看護専門学校や学校の医師・薬剤師

en.name: Raises pay for part-time doctors and others at nursery schools and schools
en.official: Regarding the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Remuneration and Reimbursement of Expenses for Part-Time Special Service Employees
en.summary: The remuneration for part-time special service employees is set by ordinance. This bill revises the remuneration for occupational physicians and doctors at nursery schools and schools, among others. It takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Raises the maximum monthly remuneration for occupational physicians from ¥634,000 to ¥672,000

Raises annual remuneration for contracted doctors at nursery schools: for internists at schools that care for children aged 0, from ¥520,000 to ¥551,000; for internists at other schools, from ¥295,000 to ¥313,000; and for dentists, from ¥130,000 to ¥137,000
Raises annual remuneration for doctors at nursing colleges from ¥124,000 to ¥131,000

Raises annual remuneration for school doctors and others: for internists, from up to ¥690,000 to up to ¥732,000; for ophthalmologists, otolaryngologists and school dentists, each from up to ¥556,000 to up to ¥589,000; for psychiatrists, from ¥630,000 to ¥668,000; and for school pharmacists, from up to ¥315,000 to up to ¥334,000
who: Doctors and pharmacists at nursing colleges and schools
